definitions.explanation: An unpleasant or painful experience; suffering mistreatment or hardship.

examples.japanese: {詐欺|さぎ}に{遭|あ}って{酷|ひど}い{目|め}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I fell victim to fraud and had an awful experience.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}には{散々|さんざん}{酷|ひど}い{目|め}に{遭|あ}わされた。
examples.english: I was put through terrible experiences by him time and again.

notes:
{酷|ひど}い{目|め} is a common expression for bad experiences.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {酷|ひど}い{目|め}に{遭|あ}う: to have a terrible experience
- {酷|ひど}い{目|め}を{見|み}る: to experience something terrible
- {酷|ひど}い{目|め}に{遭|あ}わせる: to put someone through a terrible experience

RELATED WORDS:
- {痛|いた}い{目|め}に{遭|あ}う: to learn a painful lesson
- {嫌|いや}な{思|おも}いをする: to have an unpleasant experience
- {苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}: bitter experience

WRITING:
{酷|ひど}い is often written in hiragana as ひどい.
